name: script/batch-rename
title: Batch rename with preview
summary: Batch rename with a preview: dry run by default, applied with a flag.
when: Use when many files need a new naming pattern and the user wants to see the result before anything moves.

pattern.about: New name built from {stem}, {ext} and {n} (running number, zero padded).

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, then run ./batch-rename.sh on a few sample files and only use --apply once the user has seen the preview.
